notes.title: Update - Issues Fixed
notes.content:
This update addresses the following issues:

GALLERY ROOM

 Fixed an issue where stepping on the tri-eye again in the basement would continuously play the key sound effect.
 Fixed an issue where the painting would disappear if two teammates attempted to place paintings at the same time.
 Fixed an issue where the Black River Painting could not be removed after picking up the blood heart.

TOY BOX

 Fixed an issue where the blocks in the desert level were not fully synchronized after being assembled.

OTHERS

 Disabled the synchronization of teammates' breathing sounds to avoid frequent disturbances.
 Added loading text.

Please keep sharing your bug reports and feedback in the Community Hub's Discussions section.

Much love,
SUYMO

notes.title: Update - Issues Fixed
notes.content:
This update addresses the following issues:

Toy Box
- Fixed an issue where the completion subtitle in the block level wouldn't disappear under certain circumstances.

Dark Cellar
 - Fixed an issue where the little black figure in the book's maze wouldn't respond after successfully completing it.
 - Fixed a disconnection issue occurring after completing the bullet hell game.
 - Fixed the absence of footsteps sound when jumping down into the blood pool.
 - Fixed triggers for some memoirs that were not working properly.

Gallery Room
 - Fixed an issue where the golden pipe might disappear during frequent interactions.
 - Fixed a disconnection issue occurring after being attacked by rats in the canvas room.
 - Fixed an issue where the butterfly text within the doll painting wouldn't vanish in specific situations.
 - If players get stuck outside the canvas room and falling out of the world, they can now be teleported back into it.

Miscellaneous 
 - Adjusted the tri-eye symbol network synchronization logic to prevent bugs caused by network latency.
 - Fixed a disconnection issue when getting knocked down by the ghost while reading letters.
 - Fixed multiple wall penetration issues.

Please keep sharing your bug reports and feedback in the Community Hub's Discussions section.

Much love,
SUYMO

notes.title: Update - Experience Enhancements
notes.content:
This update includes the following enhancements:

- Added shift sprint functionality; now both shift and spacebar keys can be used to sprint.
- Introduced the ability for a certain character to see rune stones, aiding players in locating remaining rune stone positions.

Toy Box - Anagrams: The lever inside the dollhouse, once pulled, cannot be interacted with again.

Gallery Room - Basement: Butterflies in the corridor no longer respawn; even if a team member (not the host) leaves, the remaining players can continue playing.

Please keep sharing your bug reports and feedback in the Community Hub's Discussions section.

With love,
SUYMO

notes.title: Update - Issues Fixed
notes.content:
This update addresses the following issues:

Toy Box - Anagrams: Adjusted the story text for easier understanding.

Dark Cellar - Prison: Added puzzle verification and fixed a puzzle bug.

Dark Cellar - Corridor: Lowered the blood pool level to prevent essential items from being lost.

Gallery Room - Basement: Fixed the issue with the ghost not disappearing. And resolved the issue where everyone was disconnected after striking the cloud.

Gallery Room - Pictured: Increased the speed of physical detection to resolve the issue of persistent black bars.

End: Added a new passage to facilitate return to the second floor.

Removed the functionality of using the E key to interact with objects, fixing the bug caused by pressing multiple keys simultaneously.

Please keep sharing your bug reports and feedback in the Community Hub's Discussions section.

Much love,
SUYMO

notes.title: Update - Issues Fixed
notes.content:
Hello everyone, this update fixes the following issues:

GALLERY ROOM - Basement: Resolved a bug where key items placed in the corridor would permanently disappear from the world after placing paintings on the easel. Now, key items that fall out of the world will respawn and drop from the player's position.

GALLERY ROOM - Pictured: Fixed a problem where the black bars were ineffective.

TOY BOX - Blocks: Fixed an issue where insufficient friction made it difficult for tiny players to walk up to platforms. Tiny players can now easily walk onto platforms.

TOY BOX - Desert: Fixed an issue where, upon reaching the end zone, some tiny players were not reverting back to normal.

Dark Cellar - Corridor: Addressed the issue where the tri-eye symbol became non-functional after successfully solving the rotating space puzzle.

Please keep sharing your bug reports and feedback in the Community Hub's Discussions section.

Much love,
SUYMO
